items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: I like, uh, I like Johnny Wigg. I like the way Johnny Wigg plays. He has a simple pure style.

ctx.x: I like to play their stuff, you know. Any other trumpet players you can think of from your records?
Uh, I like, uh, I like Johnny Wigg. I like the way Johnny Wigg plays. He has a simple pure style. I like that. Uh, he, uh, let's see, I'm trying to think of this, this other, was it Emmett Hardy?

items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: At one time, I think Johnny Wiggs had sat in with the group.

ctx.x: Bob Havens. Bob Havens sat in with us. Bill Dodson sat in with us. At one time, I think Johnny Wiggs had sat in with the group. Bob Havens. But that was while Joe was still here, I believe.
